decisions.reason: The label change is explicitly limited to the landing-page How It Works section and does not alter the separate About-page content.

The candidate already requires the landing-page cover to appear without cropping; the source reiterates that requirement but does not change its current state, and implementation status must not be propagated.
The requested wording change applies only to the landing-page How It Works label and does not revise FAQ content.
Neither the invitation label nor the book-cover presentation changes the product name or future branding.
The landing-page copy and cover adjustments do not change email authentication or dashboard access behavior.
The source does not alter transactional-email delivery, contents, provider, or notification behavior.
The source contains no change to SIWE, wallet authentication, or protected wallet flows.
Using the word collect in a landing-page invitation label does not change the automatic prize-payout behavior.
The landing-page presentation changes do not affect public API authentication or exposed information.
The invitation-label wording does not change commission amount, no-referral triggering, or recipient selection.
The source does not change no-referral ticket quantity or recipient selection.
The landing-page label and cover adjustments do not affect the referral-code source, persistence, or display locations.
